entities.name: Walton County
entities.description: A coastal county in the Florida Panhandle, governed by a five-member Board of County Commissioners under a commission-administrator form of government, with five independently elected Constitutional Officers.
common_questions: What does Walton County government actually do?
How is Walton County governed?
misconceptions: Walton County is just its beaches.

entities.name: Board of County Commissioners (BCC)
entities.description: The five-member elected legislative and policy-making body of Walton County government; adopts the annual budget and appropriates funds to departments, divisions, and Constitutional Officers.
common_questions: How is the budget approved?
How are Commissioners involved in the budget?
Why do Commissioners sometimes disagree?
misconceptions: The Board controls how Constitutional Officers spend their appropriated budgets.

entities.name: County Administrator
entities.description: Appointed by the Board of County Commissioners to oversee day-to-day County operations and implement Board policy across Board-governed departments.
common_questions: Does the County Administrator supervise the Sheriff?
misconceptions: The County Administrator supervises Constitutional Officers.

entities.name: Constitutional Officers
entities.description: Five separately elected offices under the Florida Constitution -- Clerk of Courts & County Comptroller, Property Appraiser, Sheriff, Supervisor of Elections, Tax Collector -- legally independent of the Board once budgeted.
common_questions: What do Constitutional Officers do?
Why are Constitutional Officers shown separately?
misconceptions: Constitutional Officers are County departments.
The Board controls Constitutional Officer spending.

entities.name: Sheriff's Office
entities.description: An independently elected Constitutional Officer responsible in Walton County for law enforcement, corrections, court services, animal control, fire rescue, and 911 dispatch.
common_questions: Why is the Sheriff's budget so large?
Does the Sheriff's Office run animal control and fire rescue?
How is public safety funded?
misconceptions: The Sheriff's Office only does law enforcement.
The County Administrator supervises the Sheriff.

entities.name: E911 Communications Center
entities.description: The 911 dispatch operation run by the Sheriff's Office, funded by a dedicated phone-service charge deposited into the E911 Fund.

entities.name: Emergency Management

entities.name: Reserves (Fund Balance)
